title: test: C_Encrypt/C_Sign with buffer exactly 1 byte too small
description: No test verifies that C_Encrypt and C_Sign return CKR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL (not CKR_OK, not a crash) when the output buffer is one byte smaller than needed. Edge cases: RSA-2048 output is exactly 256 bytes -- a 255-byte buffer should return CKR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL with the correct required length in *pulEncryptedDataLen. Add one test per mechanism type (RSA-OAEP, AES-GCM, ECDSA) covering this boundary.
